ai_recommendation.content:
## Rationale
The patient has no significant genetic mutations requiring
targeted therapy. Given the high PD-L1 expression (65%)
and stage IIIA disease, I recommend concurrent chemoradiation
followed by durvalumab consolidation per the PACIFIC trial.

```json
[{"item_id": "p1-i1", "kind": "recommendation",
  "text": "Recommend concurrent chemoradiation followed by durvalumab.",
  "structured": {"regimen_name": "durvalumab", "drug_class": "immunotherapy", "intent": "adjuvant"},
  "evidence_citations": ["adv-referral-packet.txt"],
  "confidence": 0.9, "alternatives": []}]
```

dissent.grounds: I dissent from the proposed chemoradiation/durvalumab plan. The referral reports an EGFR exon 19 deletion at VAF 42%; the AI's claim that no actionable mutation exists conflicts with that source. I will use an EGFR-directed regimen and document the conflict.

proposals.content: Recommend concurrent chemoradiation followed by durvalumab.

human_deliberation.rationale: Override: the AI asserted no significant actionable mutation while the referral packet reports an EGFR exon 19 deletion at VAF 42%. Chosen regimen follows the documented molecular finding.

alternatives.reason_rejected: Conflicts with the documented EGFR driver mutation.
